chapters.title: 第 1 章 · 深度学习革命

sections.title: 01 · 从十个点开始
sections.lede: 一个很小的曲线拟合问题，把机器学习最重要的问题摆在了桌面上：我们究竟想从数据里学到什么？

blocks.en: Imagine ten measured points. Each point pairs an input x with a target t. We can draw a curve through those points, but the real task is to predict t for an x that was never measured.
blocks.zh: 想象有十个观测点，每个点都把输入 x 与目标 t 配成一对。我们可以画出穿过这些点的曲线，但真正的任务，是对未见过的 x 预测 t。

blocks.en: The example uses a smooth sine wave and adds random noise to the observations. This separates an underlying pattern from the accidental variation in a finite sample.
blocks.zh: 这个例子以平滑的正弦曲线为底，再给观测值加入随机噪声。这样就能区分数据中的规律与有限样本里的偶然波动。

blocks.label: KEY IDEA / 核心概念
blocks.en: Generalization means doing well on new inputs, not merely matching the ten points we already know.
blocks.zh: 泛化指的是在新输入上也能预测得好，而不只是贴合已经看到的十个点。

sections.title: 02 · 用多项式画一条曲线
sections.titleEn: A polynomial as a linear model
sections.lede: 先选一族可以调整的曲线，再让数据决定曲线的系数。

blocks.en: A polynomial combines powers of x with adjustable coefficients. The order M decides how flexible the curve can be: M = 0 is constant, M = 1 is a straight line, and larger values allow more bends.
blocks.zh: 多项式把 x 的各次幂与可调系数组合起来。阶数 M 决定曲线的灵活度：M = 0 是常数，M = 1 是直线，更高阶可以产生更多弯曲。

blocks.formula: y(x, w) = w₀ + w₁x + w₂x² + ··· + wₘxᴹ
blocks.en: This function is nonlinear in x, yet linear in the unknown coefficients w. That is why it belongs to the family of linear models.
blocks.zh: 这个函数对 x 可以是非线性的，但对未知系数 w 是线性的，因此它仍属于线性模型。

blocks.en: Choosing a model family is a separate decision from finding its coefficients. The training points determine w only after we have chosen M and a rule for judging the fit.
blocks.zh: 选择模型族，与求出它的系数，是两项不同的决定。先确定 M 和衡量拟合好坏的规则，训练数据才能决定 w。

sections.title: 03 · 怎样定义“拟合得好”
sections.lede: 把每个预测与目标的距离变成一个可优化的数字。

blocks.en: For each training point, compare the model output y(xₙ, w) with the observed target tₙ. Squaring the difference prevents positive and negative errors from canceling one another.
blocks.zh: 对每个训练点，比较模型输出 y(xₙ, w) 与观测目标 tₙ。将差值平方，可以避免正负误差互相抵消。

blocks.en: Training can now be expressed as finding coefficients w that make E(w) small. The factor one half is a mathematical convenience and does not change the minimizing coefficients.
blocks.zh: 训练现在可以写成寻找使 E(w) 尽量小的系数 w。前面的二分之一只是方便后续推导，不改变最优系数。

blocks.label: PAUSE & THINK / 想一想
blocks.en: Would a curve with zero training error necessarily make good predictions on new points? The next section answers this.
blocks.zh: 训练误差为零的曲线，在新数据上也一定预测得好吗？下一节会回答这个问题。

sections.title: 04 · 拟合与过拟合
sections.lede: 曲线越灵活，训练误差可能越低，但这并不等于读懂了数据。

blocks.en: A constant or straight-line model misses the wave-like pattern. A moderately flexible curve can capture it. With enough degrees of freedom, a polynomial may pass through every noisy training point and still swing far away between them.
blocks.zh: 常数或直线模型抓不住波浪形的规律。适度灵活的曲线可能更贴近它。自由度太高时，多项式甚至能穿过每个带噪声的训练点，却在点与点之间剧烈摆动。

blocks.en: This is overfitting: the model has learned sample-specific noise along with the useful pattern. A separate test set gives a more honest view of performance on unseen data.
blocks.zh: 这就是过拟合：模型把样本特有的噪声也当作规律学进去了。用独立测试集评估，才能更诚实地观察对未见数据的预测能力。

blocks.label: READING LENS / 阅读视角
blocks.en: When comparing models, ask two questions: How well does it fit the training set? How well does it predict independent examples?
blocks.zh: 比较模型时，问两个问题：它对训练集拟合得怎样？它对独立样本预测得怎样？

sections.title: 05 · 给复杂度加一道约束
sections.lede: 不只是选择多项式阶数，也可以直接约束系数。

blocks.en: Large coefficients can produce a curve that twists sharply to chase individual observations. Regularization adds a penalty for large coefficients to the training objective, encouraging a smoother fit.
blocks.zh: 较大的系数可能让曲线急剧扭动，以追逐个别观测点。正则化在训练目标中加入对大系数的惩罚，鼓励更平滑的拟合。

blocks.en: The parameter λ controls the trade-off: too little regularization may leave overfitting, while too much may hide the real pattern. In this example the bias coefficient w₀ is usually excluded from the penalty.
blocks.zh: 参数 λ 控制取舍：约束太弱仍可能过拟合，太强又可能遮住真实规律。在本例中，偏置系数 w₀ 通常不计入惩罚项。

blocks.en: The takeaway is a workflow: fit on training data, choose model flexibility with held-out data, and reserve an independent test set for the final estimate of generalization.
blocks.zh: 可以把这一节记成一个流程：在训练数据上拟合，用留出的数据选择模型灵活度，最后用独立测试集估计泛化效果。
